about: I'm a Senior Flutter Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, with 7+ years of experience and 20+ production apps shipped to the App Store and Google Play. I lead mobile teams, own the architecture, and turn product requirements into fast, stable, maintainable apps for Android, iOS and Web from one Flutter codebase.

At 2B Vision Technologies I lead 10+ production Flutter apps in healthcare and logistics for TrueMedIT, including a white-label phlebotomy platform used by several labs, the SmartPGX genomics platform and a patient portal with telemedicine. Before that I built delivery, ride-hailing and booking apps at Sigi Technologies, and I've built the WiseUp suite of fintech, streaming and POS apps with Globulars since 2019.

I mentor developers in BLoC, MVVM and Clean Architecture through code reviews, pairing and structured training. I've cut app load times by moving to BLoC, caching API responses and loading data only when needed, and reduced post-release bugs by introducing code reviews, unit and widget tests, and CI checks before every release. I partner with product, design, backend and QA in Scrum sprints, and use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, ChatGPT) for faster prototyping, refactoring, code reviews and tests.
I'm open to Senior and Lead Flutter / Mobile Engineering roles: remote, hybrid or on-site, and open to relocation. Let's connect, or message me directly.
